grading_method: Each fictional answer was read against the five question-specific 0/1/2 mark anchors. Total marks are the sum of the five dimension marks. No model judging API was used.
review_note: These are AI-authored teaching references, not marks collected from actual human examiners or an official SSC marking scheme. A knowledgeable human should independently review every answer, dimension mark and reason before treating these as validated human references. Student personas do not determine marks: credit follows answer content and the rubric. Partial-credit decisions may legitimately differ after review.
input_policy: Reference grades and student names/personas are for analysis only and must not be sent to the automated judge. The judge receives the question, its rubric/reference answer and anonymized student answer.
hash_method: SHA256 of json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8') using Python default separators; rubric_hash covers questions.json and answers_hash covers student_answers.json.
